title: HistoryEntry
description: The sidecar metadata recorded for a single archived render. Written next to the PNG by the daemon's history sources and committed to the reporting branch as `entry.json`. Prose spec: docs/daemon/HISTORY.md (§ Sidecar metadata) and docs/daemon/REPORTING-BRANCH.md. Forward-compatible: consumers ignore unknown fields; additive fields do not bump the version.

HistorySourceInfo.description: Which storage backend this entry was read from. Filled in by the reader, not the writer.

id.description: Stable identifier for the source, e.g. `fs:/abs/.compose-preview-history` or `git:refs/heads/preview/main@<sha>`.

WorktreeInfo.description: The working tree the render was produced in.

id.description: Worktree dir basename, or the COMPOSEAI_WORKTREE_ID override.

GitInfo.description: Git provenance of the working tree at render time.

PreviewMetadataSnapshot.description: Preview metadata frozen at render time.

HistoryDelta.description: Cheap delta vs the previous entry of the same preview.

diffPx.description: Pixel-mode only (H5); null in metadata mode.

ssim.description: Pixel-mode only (H5); null in metadata mode.

id.description: On the FS source `<utc-timestamp>-<short-hash>`; on the reporting branch `<shortCommit>:<previewId>`.

pngHash.description: Full SHA-256 hex of the PNG bytes.

pngPath.description: Path to the PNG relative to this sidecar.

triggerDetail.description: Per-trigger free-form JSON; consumers ignore unknown shapes.

semantics.description: Optional inline compose/semantics payload captured at render time (#1785); see compose-semantics.schema.json.

a11yAtf.description: Optional inline a11y/atf payload captured at render time (#1869); see a11y-atf.schema.json.

a11yHierarchy.description: Optional inline a11y/hierarchy payload captured at render time (#1869); see a11y-hierarchy.schema.json.

a11yTouchTargets.description: Optional inline a11y/touchTargets payload captured at render time (#1869); see a11y-touch-targets.schema.json.

theme.description: Optional inline compose/theme payload captured at render time (#1869); see compose-theme.schema.json.
